text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps teams track progress and stay motivated along the way. It is also important to define deliverables clearly so everyone knows what the final results should look like. Finally, stakeholder alignment ensures that everyone involved shares the same expectations and supports the project from start to finish. When these elements are combined, projects are more likely to stay on schedule and achieve the desired outcomes.
